title: Molecular dynamics and MM-GBSA data: calx-β domain of integrin β4 bound to the IGF1R kinase domain (PDB 3QQU)
description:
Simulation inputs, trajectories and analysis behind the molecular dynamics supplement of a manuscript submitted to Biomolecules (MDPI) on calx-β binding to the IGF1R kinase.

Three independent 100 ns replicates (velocity seeds 1001–1003) of the docked calx-β domain (integrin β4 residues 989–1107) on the full IGF1R kinase domain from PDB 3QQU (missing loop 1094–1103 capped), AMBER99SB-ILDN / TIP3P, 0.15 M NaCl, GROMACS 2025.4. MM-GBSA (gmx_MMPBSA 1.7.1; GBn2 primary, OBC-II sensitivity) and computational alanine scanning of the 3A mutant (K1020A/D1021A/E1022A) with three far-field controls.

See README.md for the file layout and MANIFEST.sha256 for checksums. The notebooks in code.zip reproduce every step.
notes: Software: GROMACS 2025.4 (CUDA), PROPKA 3.5.1, PDBFixer 1.12.0 / OpenMM 8.6.1, MDTraj 1.11.2, gmx_MMPBSA 1.7.1, AmberTools 24.8, ParmEd 4.3.1, Python 3.12.
